description: The only way to give this round's answer when it is a planning segment or questions for the person. Fill the fields and call it; the platform builds and stores the answer from them. Do not write the answer as text.

parameters.plan: For "plan": the plan this guide describes.
parameters.questions: For "questions": non-empty strings, real product/auth decisions.
parameters.reason: Optional {text, affectedTaskIds?, objective?}: why this segment, its tasks, the candidate's Goal objective.
